release_notes:
- The home-screen widget renders Waze’s original speedometer and region-specific speed-limit sign. The idle dial has no readiness label.
- An Android Auto projection session can start automatic tracking alongside the Bluetooth and In vehicle triggers. Android can withhold the projection event when Waze’s process has stopped.
- Move & Resize Speedometer retains separate placements for the phone and secondary displays, including portrait and landscape.
- Verified Waze 5.27.5.0 on the emulator with Desktop Head Unit and a 1280 × 720 secondary display.
